brief_rationale: The trajectory met the responsibility chain: the doctor did not overclaim incomplete results, reconciled the uncertain external-drug/adhesive reaction, gave red-flag escalation boundaries, identified responsible inpatient teams and timing, and obtained repeated caregiver receipt. It also completed high-order verification of the ambiguous rash and dynamic reprioritization as the case moved from pre-op uncertainty to post-op/culture/negative-pressure management. No serious or minor responsibility-chain error is evident from facts visible to the doctor, and closure was safe, executable, and traceable with teach-back.

citations.explanation: Doctor gave a bounded 48-hour monitoring and escalation plan.
citations.quote: 未来48小时家属盯4件事即可

citations.explanation: Caregiver accurately received the plan and escalation boundary.

closure_assessment.explanation: The episode closes safely for the current post-op/result-follow-up phase: the family knows what to monitor, what not to do, when to call nurses urgently, and that medication/wound decisions remain with the inpatient team at the next复评节点.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure
